race.description: Star 104.5 Gina & Matty For Breakfast Hcp (Bm64)
race.comment: SMILING PROPHET (7) comes here deep into the campaign and she gets a much better set up today. Snagged back from the wide draw when warming up late to finish fifth over 1100m at this track. Key jockey change and can race much closer. Top three contender. SERINDA (5) good win at Gosford two back in easier company. Sent to town with a tiring ninth over 1250m at Canterbury in BM72 grade. Will push forward and take catching. POWDER MAN (1) capable on his day and will appreciate the extra trip. Shouldered the 60kg for a fast finishing fifth over 1200m at Kembla Grange. No shock to see him return to form quickly. OURAGAN (8) has been thereabouts all prep and comes back slightly in trip for this. Stalked the speed with a fighting third over 1400m at Newcastle. Suitably placed and anticipating another big run.
